_doc: clinic-gesture-quiet — a camera with no deliberate sign must never produce a request (Codex audit:
a 'Signed stop' appeared with no gesture in the in-app browser). Chrome's fake camera (a moving
test pattern, no hand) feeds the sign panel for ten seconds: the model runs, the reading stays
'no hand' or 'a hand, not a palm', and the heard-log stays empty. Run by run-all with the fake

eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cl-listen button')].find(b => /Enable camera/.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label') || b.textContent)); b?.click(); return !!b; })()

_doc: The camera panel counts as a capture: the voice agent is blocked with the camera reason, not a microphone one.
